tasks.label: inspect-workbooks
args: from openpyxl import load_workbook as l;w=l('output/NAME_CORRECTION_MAP.xlsx',data_only=True).active;print('MAP_COUNT',w.max_row-1);print('MAP_HEADERS',*[w.cell(1,c).value for c in range(1,w.max_column+1)],sep='|');[print('MAP_ROW',r,*[w.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,w.max_column+1)],sep='|') for r in range(2,min(w.max_row,6)+1)];wb=l('output/NAME_NORMALIZATION_REPORT.xlsx',data_only=True);s=wb['SUMMARY'];c=wb['CORRECTED_NAMES'];u=wb['UNRESOLVED_NAMES'];[print('SUMMARY_ROW',r,*[s.cell(r,k).value for k in range(1,s.max_column+1)],sep='|') for r in range(1,s.max_row+1)];print('CORRECTED_COUNT',c.max_row-1);print('UNRESOLVED_COUNT',u.max_row-1);print('CORRECTED_HEADERS',*[c.cell(1,k).value for k in range(1,c.max_column+1)],sep='|');[print('CORRECTED_ROW',r,*[c.cell(r,k).value for k in range(1,c.max_column+1)],sep='|') for r in range(2,min(c.max_row,4)+1)]

tasks.label: inspect-sales-product-type-review
args: from openpyxl import load_workbook as l;wb=l('output/SALES_PRODUCT_TYPE_REVIEW.xlsx',data_only=True);r=wb['REVIEW_79'];s=wb['SUMMARY'];print('REVIEW_HEADERS|'+'|'.join(str(r.cell(1,c).value or '') for c in range(1,r.max_column+1)));print('REVIEW_COUNT|'+str(max(r.max_row-1,0)));[print('SUMMARY_ROW|'+str(i)+'|'+str(s.cell(i,1).value)+'|'+str(s.cell(i,2).value)) for i in range(1,s.max_row+1)]

tasks.label: inspect-sales-manual-mapping
args: from openpyxl import load_workbook as l; wb=l('output/SALES_MANUAL_MAPPING.xlsx',data_only=True); m=wb['MANUAL_MAPPING']; s=wb['SUMMARY']; print('MAP_HEADERS|'+'|'.join(str(m.cell(1,c).value or '') for c in range(1,m.max_column+1))); print('MAP_ROWS|'+str(max(m.max_row-1,0))); [print('SUMMARY_ROW|'+str(i)+'|'+str(s.cell(i,1).value)+'|'+str(s.cell(i,2).value)) for i in range(1,s.max_row+1)]

tasks.label: inspect-sales-match-manual-headers
args: from openpyxl import load_workbook as l; ws=l('output/SALES_MATCH_MANUAL.xlsx',data_only=True).active; print('SHEET|'+ws.title); print('MAX|'+str(ws.max_row)+'|'+str(ws.max_column)); print('HEADERS|'+'|'.join('' if ws.cell(1,c).value is None else str(ws.cell(1,c).value) for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1))); [print('ROW|'+str(r)+'|'+'|'.join('' if ws.cell(r,c).value is None else str(ws.cell(r,c).value) for c in range(1,min(ws.max_column,10)+1))) for r in range(2,min(ws.max_row,8)+1)]

tasks.label: inspect-sales-final-control-check
args: from openpyxl import load_workbook as l;wb=l('output/SALES_FINAL_CONTROL_CHECK.xlsx',data_only=True);s=wb['SUMMARY'];n=wb['NEW_ROWS'];r=wb['REVIEW_3'];print('SHEETS|'+'|'.join(wb.sheetnames));print('SUMMARY_ROWS|'+str(s.max_row));[print('SUMMARY|'+str(s.cell(i,1).value)+'|'+str(s.cell(i,2).value)) for i in range(1,s.max_row+1) if s.cell(i,1).value is not None];print('NEW_ROWS_COUNT|'+str(max(n.max_row-1,0)));[print('NEW_ROW|'+'|'.join('' if n.cell(i,c).value is None else str(n.cell(i,c).value) for c in range(1,n.max_column+1))) for i in range(2,n.max_row+1)];print('REVIEW_COUNT|'+str(max(r.max_row-1,0)));[print('REVIEW_ROW|'+'|'.join('' if r.cell(i,c).value is None else str(r.cell(i,c).value) for c in range(1,r.max_column+1))) for i in range(2,r.max_row+1)]
